sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Lok Lambert used the spell in Brittany, France to stun Celina on a rooftop. [The Seekers of Ys]

A green version of Clatterbang was used by Diaz and his Suits to attack a house. This form of Clatterbang was fired like a projectile [The Bulls of Pamplona]

Clatterbang was used by Lok Lambert in Organization Central to render the Suit "Beta" unconscious. [Doorway to Huntik]

This spell was later used by Dante Vale to disorientate Wilder whilst fighting in Hernán Cortés' vault. [The Power of Umbra]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
*Clatterbang is the first spell to appear in the Huntik Magazine comics prior to appearing in the TV series with an altered design.
*In the comics, Clatterbang is depicted as a long-range blast as opposed to a series of circular sound waves seen in the TV show.

full_text:
Clatterbang is a spell that creates a sonic wave that can instantly knock out the opponent. The spell user's hands are placed on either side of the target's head, and a wave with a violet aura is emitted from the hands.

== History ==
Lok Lambert used the spell in Brittany, France to stun Celina on a rooftop. [The Seekers of Ys]

A green version of Clatterbang was used by Diaz and his Suits to attack a house. This form of Clatterbang was fired like a projectile [The Bulls of Pamplona]

Clatterbang was used by Lok Lambert in Organization Central to render the Suit "Beta" unconscious. [Doorway to Huntik]

This spell was later used by Dante Vale to disorientate Wilder whilst fighting in Hernán Cortés' vault. [The Power of Umbra]

== Trivia ==
*Clatterbang is the first spell to appear in the Huntik Magazine comics prior to appearing in the TV series with an altered design.
*In the comics, Clatterbang is depicted as a long-range blast as opposed to a series of circular sound waves seen in the TV show.
